title: Execute Your First RISC-V Program
objective: Run three instructions on the single-cycle processor and watch the program counter and the register file change, one instruction per clock cycle.
explanation:
A RISC-V program is a sequence of 32-bit instructions in memory. The program counter (PC) holds the address of the instruction to execute. Every cycle the processor fetches the instruction at the PC, decodes it, executes it and writes back the result to the register file (registers x0–x31; x0 is always zero). Then the PC advances by 4 bytes.

addi rd, rs1, imm computes rs1 + imm. With rs1 = x0 it simply loads a small constant. add rd, rs1, rs2 adds two registers.

This mission uses Ripes' single-cycle processor: one clock cycle executes exactly one instruction, so you can follow the PC and the registers step by step. It is an educational datapath model, not a model of a specific commercial core.
example:
# Mission 1: your first RISC-V program
addi x1, x0, 10   # x1 = 10
addi x2, x0, 20   # x2 = 20
add  x3, x1, x2   # x3 = x1 + x2

steps.title: Load the program
steps.instruction: Click Load example and Select processor. The editor now contains the program and the single-cycle processor is active.

steps.title: Execute one instruction
steps.instruction: In the toolbar, press Clock once (or step forward in the Explorer tab timeline after clocking). In the single-cycle processor the first instruction completes in cycle 1: the PC moves from 0x0 to 0x4 and x1 becomes 10.

steps.title: Run to the end
steps.instruction: Press Run (or keep clocking). Open the Explorer tab and click the add instruction in the timeline: the explanation shows the operand values 10 and 20 and checks the result against the ISA.

challenge.text: Write your own program that leaves 100 in register x5 (t0), where the final value of x5 must be produced by an add instruction. Run it to completion, then press Check challenge.
challenge.hint: Load two constants with addi into two other registers, then add them into x5.
challenge.reference_solution:
addi x6, x0, 60
addi x7, x0, 40
add  x5, x6, x7

completion: You executed RISC-V instructions and verified, from the simulator's own trace, how the PC and the register file change. Next: what happens when instructions overlap in a pipeline.

zh_CN.title: 运行你的第一个 RISC-V 程序
zh_CN.objective: 在单周期处理器上运行三条指令，观察程序计数器和寄存器堆的变化：每个时钟周期执行一条指令。
zh_CN.explanation:
RISC-V 程序是内存中的一串 32 位指令。程序计数器（PC）保存要执行的指令的地址。每个周期，处理器在 PC 处取指，对指令译码，执行它，并把结果写回到寄存器堆（寄存器 x0–x31；x0 恒为零）。然后 PC 前进 4 个字节。

addi rd, rs1, imm 计算 rs1 + imm。当 rs1 = x0 时，它只是加载一个小常数。add rd, rs1, rs2 把两个寄存器相加。

本任务使用 Ripes 的单周期处理器：一个时钟周期恰好执行一条指令，因此你可以一步一步地跟踪 PC 和寄存器。它是教学用的数据通路模型，而不是某个特定商业处理器核的模型。

steps.title: 加载程序
steps.instruction: 点击加载示例和选择处理器。编辑器中现在是示例程序，单周期处理器已被选中。

steps.title: 执行一条指令
steps.instruction: 在工具栏中按一次时钟（或在运行时钟后，于探索器选项卡的时间线中向前单步）。在单周期处理器中，第一条指令在周期 1 完成：PC 从 0x0 变为 0x4，x1 变为 10。

steps.title: 运行到结束
steps.instruction: 按运行（或继续按时钟）。打开探索器选项卡，在时间线中点击 add 指令：解释中会显示操作数的值 10 和 20，并对照 ISA 检查结果。

challenge.text: 编写你自己的程序，使寄存器 x5（t0）最终保存 100，并且 x5 的最终值必须由一条 add 指令产生。把程序运行到结束，然后按检查挑战。
challenge.hint: 先用 addi 把两个常数加载到另外两个寄存器中，再用 add 把它们相加到 x5。

zh_CN.completion: 你执行了 RISC-V 指令，并根据模拟器自己的轨迹验证了 PC 和寄存器堆是如何变化的。下一步：当指令在流水线中重叠执行时会发生什么。
